The only place a Body is turned into HTML.\n\nPreview and `cms publish` both call `render_body`, so what the editor shows is\nwhat readers get. markdown-it-py renders first, then nh3 enforces an allowlist.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom typing import Collection\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\nfrom markdown_it.token import Token\n\nALLOWED_TAGS = {\"a\", \"blockquote\", \"br\", \"code\", \"em\", \"h1\", \"h2\", \"h3\", \"h4\",\n                \"h5\", \"h6\", \"hr\", \"img\", \"li\", \"ol\", \"p\", \"pre\", \"strong\", \"ul\"}\nALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES = {\"a\": {\"href\"}, \"img\": {\"src\", \"alt\"}}\n\n# markdown-it must parse raw HTML as HTML to tell it from text (with html=False\n# it becomes escaped text instead). It is parsed only to be thrown away: every\n# raw-HTML token is dropped before rendering, so none is ever rendered and none\n# leaves text behind. nh3 below is the second layer, enforcing the allowlist on\n# whatever markdown-it produced.\n_markdown = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\", {\"html\": True})\n\n_RAW_CONTENT_TAG = re.compile(r\"<(/?)(script|style)\\b\", re.I)\n_SCHEME = re.compile(r\"^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.\\-]*:\")\n# nh3 leaves a bare <a> where it dropped the href, and an <img> with no src.\n_BARE_LINK = re.compile(r\"<a>(.*?)</a>\", re.S)\n_SRCLESS_IMG = re.compile(r\"<img(?![^>]*\\bsrc=)[^>]*>\")\n\n\ndef is_relative(target: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"True for a path like ``../other/`` or ``images/a.jpg``. Anything with a\n    scheme (http:, mailto:, javascript:), a host (//x) or a root (/x) is not.\"\"\"\n    target = re.sub(r\"[\\x00-\\x20]\", \"\", target).replace(\"\\\\\", \"/\")\n    return bool(target) and not _SCHEME.match(target) \\\n        and not target.startswith(\"/\")\n\n\ndef _drop_inline_html(children: list[Token]) -> list[Token]:\n    \"\"\"`children` without raw inline tags, and without anything between an\n    opening and closing <script> or <style> (their text is code, not prose).\"\"\"\n    kept, inside = [], None\n    for child in children:\n        if child.type == \"html_inline\":\n            found = _RAW_CONTENT_TAG.match(child.content)\n            if inside and found and found.group(1) and found.group(2).lower() == inside:\n                inside = None\n            elif not inside and found and not found.group(1):\n                inside = found.group(2).lower()\n        elif not inside:\n            kept.append(child)\n    return kept\n\n\ndef _render_without_raw_html(body: str) -> str:\n    tokens = [t for t in _markdown.parse(body) if t.type != \"html_block\"]\n    for token in tokens:\n        if token.type == \"inline\" and token.children:\n            token.children = _drop_inline_html(token.children)\n    return _markdown.renderer.render(tokens, _markdown.options, {})\n\n\ndef render_body(body: str, image_urls: Collection[str] = ()) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The sanitized HTML for a Markdown Body.\n\n    Links survive only if relative. Images survive only if their source is one\n    of `image_urls` (the Recap's own uploaded Images; none exist yet). A removed\n    link keeps its text; a removed image leaves nothing. Raw HTML in the Body is\n    removed whole: a raw block disappears, a raw inline tag disappears and the\n    Markdown text around it stays.\n    \"\"\"\n    own = set(image_urls)\n\n    def keep(tag: str, attr: str, value: str) -> str | None:\n        if tag == \"a\" and attr == \"href\":\n            return value if is_relative(value) else None\n        if tag == \"img\" and attr == \"src\":\n            return value if value in own else None\n        return value\n\n    html = nh3.clean(_render_without_raw_html(body), tags=ALLOWED_TAGS,\n                     attributes=ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES, url_schemes=set(),\n                     link_rel=None, attribute_filter=keep)\n    return _SRCLESS_IMG.sub(\"\", _BARE_LINK.sub(r\"\\1\", html))\n\"\"\"Recaps: one member's account of one Trip, and the status machine that moves\nthem from Draft to Published.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom app import db\n\n\nclass RecapLocked(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"An Editor's write found the Recap no longer their own Draft.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SlugTaken(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Another Recap on this Trip already uses this Slug.\"\"\"\n\n\n# Appended to an Editor's write so the write itself checks what the policy\n# checked a moment earlier; the Recap may have been Submitted in between.\n_EDITOR_DRAFT_ONLY = \" AND status = 'draft' AND owner_id = ?\"\n\n\ndef get_recap(recap_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    \"\"\"One Recap with its Owner's name, or None.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT recap.*, account.name AS owner_name FROM recap \"\n            \"JOIN account ON account.id = recap.owner_id WHERE recap.id = ?\",\n            (recap_id,)).fetchone()\n\n\ndef update_recap(recap_id: int, trip_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str,\n                 byline_name: str, byline_class_year: int,\n                 editor_id: int | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Overwrite a Recap's editable fields and stamp the edit time. The Owner,\n    status and created time never change here. Raises SlugTaken on a clash.\n\n    Pass `editor_id` for an Editor: the write then applies only if that Editor\n    still owns a Draft, checked in the UPDATE itself, else RecapLocked.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            cur = conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE recap SET trip_id = ?, title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?, \"\n                \"byline_name = ?, byline_class_year = ?, \"\n                \"edited_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now') \"\n                f\"WHERE id = ?{_EDITOR_DRAFT_ONLY if editor_id else ''}\",\n                (trip_id, title, slug, body, byline_name, byline_class_year,\n                 recap_id, *((editor_id,) if editor_id else ())))\n            if editor_id and cur.rowcount == 0:\n                raise RecapLocked(recap_id)\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n        if \"UNIQUE\" not in str(exc):\n            raise\n        raise SlugTaken(slug) from exc\n\n\ndef list_recaps(owner_id: int | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"Recaps with Trip and Owner names, newest first; only owner_id's if given.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT recap.*, trip.conference AS trip_name, \"\n            \"account.name AS owner_name FROM recap \"\n            \"JOIN trip ON trip.id = recap.trip_id \"\n            \"JOIN account ON account.id = recap.owner_id \"\n            \"WHERE (? IS NULL OR recap.owner_id = ?) \"\n            \"ORDER BY recap.created_at DESC, recap.id DESC\",\n            (owner_id, owner_id)).fetchall()\n\n\ndef delete_recap(recap_id: int, editor_id: int | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Delete a Recap. Pass `editor_id` for an Editor: it is deleted only if\n    that Editor still owns a Draft, checked in the DELETE itself, else\n    RecapLocked.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            f\"DELETE FROM recap WHERE id = ?\"\n            f\"{_EDITOR_DRAFT_ONLY if editor_id else ''}\",\n            (recap_id, *((editor_id,) if editor_id else ())))\n        if editor_id and cur.rowcount == 0:\n            raise RecapLocked(recap_id)\n\n\ndef create_recap(trip_id: int, owner_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str,\n                 byline_name: str, byline_class_year: int) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Insert a Draft Recap; return its id. The Body is stored as written.\n\n    Raises SlugTaken if the Trip already has a Recap with this Slug. The\n    UNIQUE (trip_id, slug) constraint decides, so two simultaneous saves\n    cannot both win.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            cur = conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO recap (trip_id, owner_id, title, slug, body, \"\n                \"byline_name, byline_class_year) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                (trip_id, owner_id, title, slug, body, byline_name,\n                 byline_class_year))\n            return cur.lastrowid\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n        if \"UNIQUE\" not in str(exc):\n            raise\n        raise SlugTaken(slug) from exc\n\n\nclass TransitionRefused(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"The Recap is not in a status this action can start from.\"\"\"\n\n\n# action -> (statuses it may start from, status it ends in). Who may do each\n# action is the policy's business, not this table's.\nTRANSITIONS: dict[str, tuple[tuple[str, ...], str]] = {\n    \"submit\": ((\"draft\",), \"submitted\"),\n    \"send-back\": ((\"submitted\",), \"draft\"),\n    \"publish\": ((\"draft\", \"submitted\"), \"published\"),\n    \"unpublish\": ((\"published\",), \"draft\"),\n}\n\n\n# Publishing stamps the time; Unpublishing clears it.\nPUBLISHED_AT_SQL = {\n    \"publish\": \", published_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')\",\n    \"unpublish\": \", published_at = NULL\",\n}\n\n\ndef transition(recap_id: int, action: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Move a Recap along `action`. The status is checked inside the UPDATE, so\n    two simultaneous requests cannot both move it. Raises TransitionRefused.\"\"\"\n    from_statuses, to_status = TRANSITIONS[action]\n    marks = \", \".join(\"?\" for _ in from_statuses)\n    stamp = PUBLISHED_AT_SQL.get(action, \"\")\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            f\"UPDATE recap SET status = ?{stamp} WHERE id = ? \"\n            f\"AND status IN ({marks})\",\n            (to_status, recap_id, *from_statuses))\n        if cur.rowcount == 0:\n            raise TransitionRefused(action)\n\"\"\"The permission policy: can this Account do this action to this object?\n\nEvery route asks `can` (through `security.require`); routes never check roles\nthemselves. Unknown actions are denied. Add an action here when a ticket adds a\ncapability. Rules that depend on the object (an Editor's own Draft) take the\n`obj` argument.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app.accounts import Account\n\nADMIN = \"admin\"\nEDITOR = \"editor\"\n\n# action -> roles allowed to do it\nROLE_RULES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n    \"console.view\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"accounts.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"trips.manage\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.create\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.view\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.edit\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.delete\": frozenset({ADMIN, EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.submit\": frozenset({EDITOR}),\n    \"recaps.publish\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.unpublish\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n    \"recaps.send_back\": frozenset({ADMIN}),\n}\n\n# Actions on one Recap. An Editor may do these only to a Draft they Own; an\n# Admin may do them to any Recap. `obj` is the Recap row.\nRECAP_ACTIONS = frozenset({\"recaps.view\", \"recaps.edit\", \"recaps.delete\"})\n\n\n# Only the Editor who Owns a Draft Submits it (an Admin has no row for this).\nOWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS = frozenset({\"recaps.submit\"})\n\n\ndef can(account: Account | None, action: str, obj: object | None = None) -> bool:\n    if account is None or not account.active:\n        return False\n    if account.role not in ROLE_RULES.get(action, frozenset()):\n        return False\n    if action in OWN_DRAFT_ACTIONS:\n        return (obj is not None and obj[\"owner_id\"] == account.id\n                and obj[\"status\"] == \"draft\")\n    if action in RECAP_ACTIONS and account.role != ADMIN:\n        return (obj is not None and obj[\"owner_id\"] == account.id\n                and obj[\"status\"] == \"draft\")\n    return True\n\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nT00 publishes a placeholder home page. As you build content types, extend\nrender_site() to write one file per published item. Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.markdown import render_body\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef _published_recaps() -> dict[int, list]:\n    \"\"\"Published Recaps by trip id, each list in the order they were Published.\n    The only place `cms publish` reads Recaps: nothing else is ever selected.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        rows = conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM recap WHERE status = 'published' \"\n            \"ORDER BY published_at, id\").fetchall()\n    by_trip: dict[int, list] = {}\n    for row in rows:\n        by_trip.setdefault(row[\"trip_id\"], []).append(row)\n    return by_trip\n\n\ndef _write(env: Environment, path: Path, template: str, depth: int,\n           **context) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Render `template` to `path`, with every link back to the site root\n    computed from the page's `depth` below it.\"\"\"\n    root = \"../\" * depth\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    path.write_text(env.get_template(template).render(\n        site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE, css_path=f\"{root}style.css\",\n        home_path=f\"{root}index.html\", instagram_url=settings.INSTAGRAM_URL,\n        **context))\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n\n    published = _published_recaps()\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        trips = [t for t in conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT * FROM trip ORDER BY start_date DESC, id DESC\")\n            if t[\"id\"] in published]\n\n    _write(env, out / \"index.html\", \"public/home.html\", 0,\n           title=settings.SITE_TITLE,\n           items=[{\"href\": f\"trips/{t['slug']}/\", \"title\": t[\"conference\"],\n                   \"dates\": f\"{t['city']}, {t['start_date']}\"} for t in trips])\n    for trip in trips:\n        trip_dir = out / \"trips\" / trip[\"slug\"]\n        _write(env, trip_dir / \"index.html\", \"public/trip.html\", 2,\n               title=trip[\"conference\"], trip=trip,\n               recaps=published[trip[\"id\"]])\n        for recap in published[trip[\"id\"]]:\n            _write(env, trip_dir / recap[\"slug\"] / \"index.html\",\n                   \"public/recap.html\", 3, title=recap[\"title\"], trip=trip,\n                   recap=recap, body_html=render_body(recap[\"body\"]))\n    return out\n\"\"\"Sessions, CSRF and the route guard.\n\nThe session is a signed cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, itsdangerous\nunderneath) holding the Account id and a CSRF token. The Account itself is\nreread from the database on every request.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nfrom typing import Callable\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import accounts, policy\nfrom app.accounts import Account\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\nLOGIN_URL = \"/login\"\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The session's CSRF token, created on first use.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nasync def csrf_protect(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: refuse any state-changing request without the token.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    form = await request.form()\n    sent = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not (isinstance(sent, str) and expected\n            and secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected)):\n        raise HTTPException(403, \"Missing or invalid CSRF token\")\n\n\ndef current_account(request: Request) -> Account | None:\n    \"\"\"Reread the signed-in Account; a Deactivated one counts as signed out.\"\"\"\n    account_id = request.session.get(\"account_id\")\n    account = accounts.get(account_id) if account_id else None\n    if account is None or not account.active:\n        request.session.pop(\"account_id\", None)\n        return None\n    return account\n\n\ndef require(action: str) -> Callable[..., Account]:\n    \"\"\"Route dependency: logged out -> login page, not allowed -> 403.\"\"\"\n\n    def guard(account: Account | None = Depends(current_account)) -> Account:\n        if account is None:\n            raise HTTPException(303, headers={\"Location\": LOGIN_URL})\n        if not policy.can(account, action):\n            raise HTTPException(403, \"You do not have permission to do that\")\n        return account\n\n    return guard\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nThe admin console lives under /admin, with /login and /logout beside it; the\npublic site answers at /. Add routes in their own modules under app/routes/ and\ninclude them here. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport logging\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.routes import accounts, auth, console, recaps, trips\nfrom app.security import csrf_protect\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\n\nlog = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    if settings.SECRET_KEY_IS_DEV_DEFAULT:\n        log.warning(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY is not set: sessions are signed with the \"\n                    \"public development key. Development use only.\")\n    db.init_db()\n    # csrf_protect runs on every route, so no state-changing route can skip it.\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\", dependencies=[Depends(csrf_protect)])\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=\"cms_session\", same_site=\"lax\",\n                       https_only=False)\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(console.router)\n    app.include_router(accounts.router)\n    app.include_router(trips.router)\n    app.include_router(recaps.router)\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"site_title\": settings.SITE_TITLE,\n             \"items\": [], \"css_path\": \"style.css\", \"home_path\": \"index.html\",\n             \"instagram_url\": settings.INSTAGRAM_URL},\n        )\n\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n\"\"\"Configuration, read from the environment (never hard-code secrets).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nTEMPLATES = ROOT / \"templates\"\nSITE = ROOT / \"site\"\n\n# DEVELOPMENT ONLY: this fallback key is public, so anyone can forge a session\n# cookie signed with it. It exists so `cms serve` starts with no .env. Set\n# CMS_SECRET_KEY for anything real; create_app() logs a warning while it is used.\nDEV_SECRET_KEY = \"dev-only-not-for-production\"\nSECRET_KEY = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY\", DEV_SECRET_KEY)\nSECRET_KEY_IS_DEV_DEFAULT = SECRET_KEY == DEV_SECRET_KEY\nDATABASE_PATH = Path(os.environ.get(\"CMS_DATABASE\", ROOT / \"cms.db\"))\nSITE_TITLE = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SITE_TITLE\", \"My CMS\")\n# Set this to your Pages URL once you deploy, e.g.\n# https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\nBASE_PATH = os.environ.get(\"CMS_BASE_PATH\", \"\")\n# The club's Instagram, linked from every page's footer for discussion. A\n# committed constant, not an environment variable: replace the placeholder.\nINSTAGRAM_URL = \"https://www.instagram.com/REPLACE-ME/\"\n\"\"\"SQLite access. The database path is read from settings on every call.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\nfrom typing import Iterator\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS account (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    name          TEXT NOT NULL,\n    class_year    INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    active        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trip (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    conference TEXT NOT NULL,\n    city       TEXT NOT NULL,\n    start_date TEXT NOT NULL,\n    end_date   TEXT NOT NULL,\n    summary    TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),\n    edited_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recap (\n    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    trip_id           INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES trip (id),\n    owner_id          INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES account (id),\n    title             TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug              TEXT NOT NULL,\n    body              TEXT NOT NULL,\n    byline_name       TEXT NOT NULL,\n    byline_class_year INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    status            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                      CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'published')),\n    created_at        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),\n    edited_at         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),\n    published_at      TEXT,\n    UNIQUE (trip_id, slug)\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS site_state (\n    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),\n    last_rendered_at  TEXT\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open a connection; commit on success, roll back on error, always close.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    try:\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    except BaseException:\n        conn.rollback()\n        raise\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef _add_column_if_missing(conn: sqlite3.Connection, table: str, column: str,\n                           definition: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS never alters a table that already exists, so\n    a column added to SCHEMA later is added here for databases made before it.\"\"\"\n    existing = {row[\"name\"] for row in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info({table})\")}\n    if column not in existing:\n        try:\n            conn.execute(f\"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {definition}\")\n        except sqlite3.OperationalError as exc:\n            # Another process started at the same moment and added it first.\n            if \"duplicate column name\" not in {"parentUuid":"f71a047f-ca35-4add-895c-c8f22da93ed4","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"62ba9a60-66fc-40cf-a656-ee766651ee35","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_016p3h8r2MsymCnLV4YUbJqn","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Recap Drafts: Editors write their own; Admins can act on any.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Callable\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import policy, recaps, trips\nfrom app.flash import flash\nfrom app.markdown import render_body\nfrom app.accounts import Account\nfrom app.routes.accounts import CLASS_YEAR, CLASS_YEAR_RANGE\nfrom app.security import require\nfrom app.slugs import is_url_safe, slugify\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/recaps\")\n\nBYLINE_ERROR = (\"A Byline needs both the writer's name and a four-digit \"\n                \"class year, such as 2027.\")\nTRIP_ERROR = \"Choose one of the existing Trips.\"\nBODY_ERROR = \"The Body cannot be empty.\"\nSUBMIT_EMPTY_ERROR = \"A Recap with an empty Body cannot be Submitted.\"\nLIVE_NOTICE = (\"This Recap is Published, so the change is still live until you \"\n               \"Deploy.\")\nLOCKED_ERROR = (\"This Recap was Submitted or Published, so it can no longer \"\n                \"be changed by its Editor.\")\nTRANSITION_ERROR = \"That change is not allowed for a Recap in its current status.\"\nTITLE_ERROR = \"The title cannot be blank.\"\nSLUG_ERROR = \"The Slug cannot be blank.\"\nSLUG_UNSAFE_ERROR = (\"A Slug may only use lowercase letters, digits and single \"\n                     \"hyphens, such as chicago-food-crawl.\")\nSLUG_TAKEN_ERROR = (\"That Slug is already in use by another Recap on this \"\n                    \"Trip. Choose a different one.\")\n\n\n# URL name -> (policy action, button label), in the order the buttons show.\nSTATUS_ACTIONS = {\n    \"submit\": (\"recaps.submit\", \"Submit\"),\n    \"send-back\": (\"recaps.send_back\", \"Send back\"),\n    \"publish\": (\"recaps.publish\", \"Publish\"),\n    \"unpublish\": (\"recaps.unpublish\", \"Unpublish\"),\n}\n\n\ndef _available_actions(account: Account, recap) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(URL name, label) of the status changes this person may make to this\n    Recap right now: the policy says who, the status machine says from where.\"\"\"\n    if recap is None:\n        return []\n    return [(name, label) for name, (policy_action, label)\n            in STATUS_ACTIONS.items()\n            if recap[\"status\"] in recaps.TRANSITIONS[name][0]\n            and policy.can(account, policy_action, recap)]\n\n\ndef _form(request: Request, account: Account, values: dict, action: str,\n          title: str, error: str | None = None, status_code: int = 200,\n          recap=None, preview_html: str | None = None):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/recap_form.html\",\n        {\"title\": title, \"account\": account, \"values\": values,\n         \"action\": action, \"trips\": trips.list_trips(), \"error\": error,\n         \"recap\": recap, \"status_actions\": _available_actions(account, recap),\n         \"preview_html\": preview_html},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\ndef _typed_byline(name: str, class_year: str):\n    \"\"\"(name, class year) from what an Admin typed, or None if either part is\n    missing or the year is not a four-digit year.\"\"\"\n    name, class_year = name.strip(), class_year.strip()\n    if not name or not CLASS_YEAR.fullmatch(class_year) \\\n            or int(class_year) not in CLASS_YEAR_RANGE:\n        return None\n    return name, int(class_year)\n\n\ndef _editor_id(account: Account) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"The id to pin a write to an Editor's own Draft; None leaves an Admin's\n    writes unrestricted.\"\"\"\n    return None if account.role == policy.ADMIN else account.id\n\n\ndef _allowed_recap(recap_id: int, account: Account, action: str):\n    \"\"\"The Recap, if it exists and this Account may do `action` to it.\"\"\"\n    recap = recaps.get_recap(recap_id)\n    if recap is None:\n        raise HTTPException(404, \"No such Recap\")\n    if not policy.can(account, action, recap):\n        raise HTTPException(403, \"You do not have permission to do that\")\n    return recap\n\n\ndef _save(request: Request, account: Account, form: dict[str, str],\n          action: str, title: str,\n          save: Callable[[int, str, str, str, str, int], object],\n          existing=None):\n    \"\"\"Validate the form, then save with (trip_id, title, slug, body, byline\n    name, byline class year). On a refusal re-show the form with a 400.\n\n    An Editor's Byline is never read from the form: it is their Account's on\n    creation and unchanged on edit. An Admin types it.\n    \"\"\"\n    if account.role == policy.ADMIN:\n        byline = _typed_byline(form[\"byline_name\"], form[\"byline_class_year\"])\n    elif existing is not None:\n        byline = existing[\"byline_name\"], existing[\"byline_class_year\"]\n    else:\n        byline = account.name, account.class_year\n\n    trip_id = form[\"trip_id\"]\n    error = (BYLINE_ERROR if byline is None\n             else TRIP_ERROR if not trip_id.isdigit()\n             or trips.get_trip(int(trip_id)) is None\n             else TITLE_ERROR if not form[\"title\"].strip()\n             else SLUG_ERROR if not form[\"slug\"].strip()\n             else SLUG_UNSAFE_ERROR if not is_url_safe(form[\"slug\"].strip())\n             else BODY_ERROR if not form[\"body\"].strip() else None)\n    if not error:\n        try:\n            save(int(trip_id), form[\"title\"].strip(), form[\"slug\"].strip(),\n                 form[\"body\"], *byline)\n        except recaps.SlugTaken:\n            error = SLUG_TAKEN_ERROR\n        except recaps.RecapLocked:\n            raise HTTPException(409, LOCKED_ERROR)\n        else:\n            if existing is not None and existing[\"status\"] == \"published\":\n                flash(request, LIVE_NOTICE)\n    if error:\n        return _form(request, account, form, action, title, error, 400,\n                     recap=existing)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/recaps\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_recaps(request: Request,\n                account: Account = Depends(require(\"console.view\"))):\n    # Editors see only their own Recaps; Admins see all of them.\n    owner_id = None if account.role == policy.ADMIN else account.id\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/recaps.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Recaps\", \"account\": account,\n         \"recaps\": recaps.list_recaps(owner_id)})\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_recap(request: Request,\n              account: Account = Depends(require(\"recaps.create\")),\n              title: str = \"\", trip_id: str = \"\"):\n    values = {\"trip_id\": trip_id, \"title\": title, \"slug\": slugify(title)}\n    return _form(request, account, values, \"/admin/recaps\", \"New Recap\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{recap_id}\")\ndef edit_recap_form(recap_id: int, request: Request,\n                    account: Account = Depends(require(\"console.view\"))):\n    recap = _allowed_recap(recap_id, account, \"recaps.view\")\n    values = {k: recap[k] for k in (\"trip_id\", \"title\", \"slug\", \"body\",\n                                    \"byline_name\", \"byline_class_year\")}\n    return _form(request, account, values, f\"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}\",\n                 \"Edit Recap\", recap=recap)\n\n\ndef _move(request: Request, recap_id: int, account: Account, action: str, policy_action: str):\n    \"\"\"Run one status change: the policy decides who, the status machine\n    decides from which status. A refusal is a 403 or a 409 and changes nothing.\"\"\"\n    recap = _allowed_recap(recap_id, account, policy_action)\n    if action == \"submit\" and not recap[\"body\"].strip():\n        raise HTTPException(400, SUBMIT_EMPTY_ERROR)\n    try:\n        recaps.transition(recap_id, action)\n    except recaps.TransitionRefused:\n        raise HTTPException(409, TRANSITION_ERROR)\n    if action == \"unpublish\":\n        flash(request, LIVE_NOTICE)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/recaps\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{recap_id}/submit\")\ndef submit_recap(recap_id: int, request: Request,\n                 account: Account = Depends(require(\"console.view\"))):\n    return _move(request, recap_id, account, \"submit\", \"recaps.submit\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{recap_id}/send-back\")\ndef send_back_recap(recap_id: int, request: Request,\n                    account: Account = Depends(require(\"recaps.send_back\"))):\n    return _move(request, recap_id, account, \"send-back\", \"recaps.send_back\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{recap_id}/publish\")\ndef publish_recap(recap_id: int, request: Request,\n                  account: Account = Depends(require(\"recaps.publish\"))):\n    return _move(request, recap_id, account, \"publish\", \"recaps.publish\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{recap_id}/unpublish\")\ndef unpublish_recap(recap_id: int, request: Request,\n                    account: Account = Depends(require(\"recaps.unpublish\"))):\n    return _move(request, recap_id, account, \"unpublish\", \"recaps.unpublish\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{recap_id}/delete\")\ndef delete_recap(recap_id: int,\n                 account: Account = Depends(require(\"console.view\"))):\n    _allowed_recap(recap_id, account, \"recaps.delete\")\n    try:\n        recaps.delete_recap(recap_id, _editor_id(account))\n    except recaps.RecapLocked:\n        raise HTTPException(409, LOCKED_ERROR)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/recaps\", status_code=303)\n\n\ndef _form_values(trip_id, title, slug, body, byline_name, byline_class_year):\n    return {\"trip_id\": trip_id, \"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": body,\n            \"byline_name\": byline_name, \"byline_class_year\": byline_class_year}\n\n\n@router.post(\"/preview\")\ndef preview_new_recap(request: Request,\n                      account: Account = Depends(require(\"recaps.create\")),\n                      trip_id: str = Form(\"\"), title: str = Form(\"\"),\n                      slug: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\"),\n                      byline_name: str = Form(\"\"),\n                      byline_class_year: str = Form(\"\")):\n    values = _form_values(trip_id, title, slug, body, byline_name,\n                          byline_class_year)\n    return _form(request, account, values, \"/admin/recaps\", \"New Recap\",\n                 preview_html=render_body(body))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{recap_id}/preview\")\ndef preview_recap(recap_id: int, request: Request,\n                  account: Account = Depends(require(\"console.view\")),\n                  trip_id: str = Form(\"\"), title: str = Form(\"\"),\n                  slug: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\"),\n                  byline_name: str = Form(\"\"),\n                  byline_class_year: str = Form(\"\")):\n    recap = _allowed_recap(recap_id, account, \"recaps.edit\")\n    values = _form_values(trip_id, title, slug, body, byline_name,\n                          byline_class_year)\n    return _form(request, account, values, f\"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}\",\n                 \"Edit Recap\", recap=recap, preview_html=render_body(body))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{recap_id}\")\ndef edit_recap(recap_id: int, request: Request,\n               account: Account = Depends(require(\"console.view\")),\n               trip_id: str = Form(\"\"), title: str = Form(\"\"),\n               slug: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\"),\n               byline_name: str = Form(\"\"),\n               byline_class_year: str = Form(\"\")):\n    recap = _allowed_recap(recap_id, account, \"recaps.edit\")\n    form = {\"trip_id\": trip_id, \"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": body,\n            \"byline_name\": byline_name, \"byline_class_year\": byline_class_year}\n    return _save(request, account, form, f\"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}\",\n                 \"Edit Recap\",\n                 lambda *fields: recaps.update_recap(\n                     recap_id, *fields, editor_id=_editor_id(account)),\n                 existing=recap)\n\n\n@router.post(\"\")\ndef create_recap(request: Request,\n                 account: Account = Depends(require(\"recaps.create\")),\n                 trip_id: str = Form(\"\"), title: str = Form(\"\"),\n                 slug: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\"),\n }}</small></p>\n  <article>{{ body_html | safe }}</article>\n{% endblock %}\n\"\"\"Shared test fixtures.\n\n`client` gives you the app, backed by a temporary database that is seeded with\nthe demo Admin and Editor Accounts. `client_as(role)` gives you a client that is\nlogged in as the seeded Account of that role, so access-control tests stay one\nline:\n\n    def test_editor_cannot_manage_users(client_as):\n        assert client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/users\").status_code in (302, 403)\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, seed, settings\nfrom app.main import create_app\n\n# The emails come from app.seed, which scripts/seed_demo.py also uses. The real\n# script reads passwords from the environment; in tests they are fixed and\n# meaningless.\nDEMO_USERS = {\n    \"admin\": {\"email\": seed.ADMIN_EMAIL, \"password\": \"test-admin-pw\"},\n    \"editor\": {\"email\": seed.EDITOR_EMAIL, \"password\": \"test-editor-pw\"},\n}\n\nTOKEN_FIELD = re.compile(r'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"')\n\n\ndef csrf_from(response) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Pull the hidden CSRF token out of a rendered form.\"\"\"\n    match = TOKEN_FIELD.search(response.text)\n    assert match, \"page has no csrf_token field\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef database(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    \"\"\"A fresh database file, seeded with the demo Accounts.\"\"\"\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"DATABASE_PATH\", tmp_path / \"test.db\")\n    db.init_db()\n    seed.seed_accounts(DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"password\"],\n                       DEMO_USERS[\"editor\"][\"password\"])\n    return settings.DATABASE_PATH\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client(database) -> TestClient:\n    return TestClient(create_app())\n\n\ndef log_in(c: TestClient, email: str, password: str):\n    token = csrf_from(c.get(\"/login\"))\n    return c.post(\"/login\", data={\"email\": email, \"password\": password,\n                                  \"csrf_token\": token},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef client_as(database):\n    \"\"\"Return a factory: client_as(\"editor\") -> a logged-in TestClient.\"\"\"\n\n    def _login(role: str) -> TestClient:\n        user = DEMO_USERS[role]\n        c = TestClient(create_app())\n        response = log_in(c, user[\"email\"], user[\"password\"])\n        assert response.status_code in (200, 302, 303), (\n            f\"Login as {role} failed with {response.status_code}\")\n        return c\n\n    return _login\n\"\"\"T04: the Recap status machine, sanitized Markdown and Preview.\n\nSeam: the HTTP app, through TestClient. Routes under test:\n\n    POST /admin/recaps/{id}/submit | send-back | publish | unpublish\n    POST /admin/recaps/{id}/preview   (an existing Recap's editor)\n    POST /admin/recaps/preview        (the New Recap editor)\n\nPreview re-renders the editor with the sanitized Body inside <section id=\"preview\">.\n\"\"\"\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import db, recaps\nfrom tests.test_t03 import (BODY, RECAPS, make_recap, make_trip, post,\n                            recap_form, recap_row, second_editor)\n\nLIVE_NOTICE = \"still live until you Deploy\"\nREFUSED = (400, 403, 409)\n\n\n# ---- helpers --------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef editors_recap(client_as, status=\"draft\"):\n    \"\"\"An Editor's Recap, moved to `status` through the real routes.\n    Returns (recap_id, trip_id).\"\"\"\n    trip_id = make_trip(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    recap_id = make_recap(client_as(\"editor\"), trip_id)\n    if status in (\"submitted\", \"published\"):\n        assert post(client_as(\"editor\"), f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/submit\"\n                    ).status_code == 303\n    if status == \"published\":\n        assert post(client_as(\"admin\"), f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/publish\"\n                    ).status_code == 303\n    assert recap_row(recap_id)[\"status\"] == status\n    return recap_id, trip_id\n\n\ndef action_forms(html):\n    \"\"\"{form action: form html} for every <form> on the page.\"\"\"\n    return {m.group(1): m.group(0) for m in re.finditer(\n        r'<form[^>]*action=\"([^\"]+)\"[^>]*>.*?</form>', html, re.S)}\n\n\ndef preview_region(html):\n    match = re.search(r'<section id=\"preview\">(.*?)</section>', html, re.S)\n    assert match, \"page has no <section id=\\\"preview\\\">\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\n# ---- the status machine: allowed transitions ------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"actor,start,action,end\", [\n    (\"editor\", \"draft\", \"submit\", \"submitted\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"submitted\", \"send-back\", \"draft\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"draft\", \"publish\", \"published\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"submitted\", \"publish\", \"published\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"published\", \"unpublish\", \"draft\"),\n])\ndef test_allowed_transitions_move_the_status(client_as, actor, start, action,\n                                              end):\n    recap_id, _ = editors_recap(client_as, start)\n    r = post(client_as(actor), f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/{action}\")\n    assert r.status_code == 303\n    assert recap_row(recap_id)[\"status\"] == end\n\n\n# ---- the status machine: transitions not in the table ---------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"actor,start,action\", [\n    (\"editor\", \"submitted\", \"submit\"),\n    (\"editor\", \"published\", \"submit\"),\n    # Only the Editor who {"parentUuid":"ad480536-601f-4aac-9d3b-c18909390186","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"62ba9a60-66fc-40cf-a656-ee766651ee35","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01XEQvGsggUf7WS6NC8cbs4b","type":"tool_result","content":"1:Vocabulary follows `CONTEXT.md`. Decisions behind it: ADR-001 (local admin console, static Public site), ADR-002 (stack), ADR-003 (Editors write at the Sunday meetings; only Admins Publish).\n5:The Kenyon Model UN club has no website. Trip recaps go on Instagram, where they sink in the feed, so nobody in the Kenyon community can look back at a past Trip. The President and Vice President want a place where members' Recaps of each Trip (where the team went, how the competition went, what they explored and ate) are published with photos and stay findable. Members need to be able to write their own Recaps. The officers must stay in control of what reaches readers, and no member can ever change another member's work or touch accounts.\n11:- An **admin console** that runs only on the **Console laptop**. Admins and Editors log in to it. Editors write their own Recaps at the Sunday club meetings and Submit them. Admins review, edit, Send back, or Publish them. Admins also manage Trips, Pages, and Accounts, and enter Recaps for Contributors who email their writing in.\n12:- A static **Public site** that an Admin Deploys from the terminal. It lists Trips newest first. Each Trip page shows its Summary and then its Published Recaps. Admin-written Pages, such as \"About the club\", form the Navigation bar. A footer link sends readers to Instagram for discussion. Only Published content reaches the Public site, and all of it is sanitized.\n14:An Admin can also take a dated Backup of the database and Images with `cms backup`, so losing the laptop doesn't lose the club's writing.\n31:9. As an Editor, I want to create Recaps, edit and delete my own Drafts, add Images to them, and Submit them, so that I can contribute without waiting on an officer.\n32:10. As an Admin, I want an Editor to be unable to Publish or Unpublish anything, so that Published always means an Admin approved it.\n34:12. As an Editor, I want my Recap locked against my own edits once it is Submitted or Published, so that what an Admin reviewed doesn't change underneath them.\n52:24. As an Admin, I want every Recap to record its Owner and when it was created, last edited, and Published, so that I know who is responsible for it and how fresh it is.\n56:28. As an Admin, I want to Publish a Draft or Submitted Recap, so that it goes out with the next Deploy.\n57:29. As an Admin, I want to Unpublish a Published Recap back to Draft, so that I can take it down at the next Deploy.\n58:30. As an Admin editing or Unpublishing a Published Recap or Page, I want a notice that the change is \"still live until you Deploy\", so that I don't assume readers already see the change.\n61:**Images**\n63:32. As an Editor, I want to upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP photo of up to about 5 MB to my Recap, with required alt text, so that my Recap has pictures that screen readers can describe.\n64:33. As an Editor, I want the console to give me a ready-to-paste Markdown snippet with my alt text filled in after an upload, so that I can place the photo where I want it in my Body.\n65:34. As an Admin, I want uploads of any other file type, or larger files, refused with a clear message, so that the Public site doesn't fill up with huge or unsafe files.\n66:35. As an Admin, I want Publish refused while the Body has an image without alt text, so that the Public site stays accessible.\n67:36. As an Admin, I want a Recap's Images deleted along with the Recap, so that orphaned photos don't pile up.\n71:37. As an Admin, I want to create, edit, and delete Pages (title, Slug, text-only Markdown Body, Draft or Published), so that the club has an \"About\" page and an \"Officers and contact\" page.\n74:40. As an Admin, I want a Page Slug refused if it is reserved (`trips`, `images`, `admin`, `login`) or already used by another Page, so that addresses never collide.\n79:42. As an Admin, I want a dashboard showing counts of Recaps by status (Draft, Submitted, Published), Trips, Pages by status, and active Accounts, so that I can see at a glance what needs attention.\n81:44. As an Admin, I want a \"changes not yet live\" notice on the dashboard whenever content has changed since the last `cms publish`, so that I remember to Deploy.\n85:48. As an Editor or Admin, I want a Preview button on the Recap and Page editor that reloads the page showing the sanitized, rendered Body exactly as readers will see it, so that I can check formatting and Image placement before saving or Submitting.\n99:56. As a reader, I want each Trip's page to show its Summary and then its Published Recaps in the order they were Published, with their Bylines, so that I get the overview and then each member's story.\n100:57. As a reader, I want a Trip to appear only once it has at least one Published Recap, so that I never land on an empty Trip.\n101:58. As a reader, I want a Navigation bar with Home first, then the Published Pages in the order the Admins set, so that \"About the club\" is always one click away.\n103:60. As an Admin, I want `cms publish` to write only Published Recaps and Pages, and only Trips that have a Published Recap, into `site/`, so that Drafts and Submitted Recaps never leak.\n104:61. As an Admin, I want every Body sanitized when it is rendered, with scripts and raw HTML stripped and external links and external images removed, so that nothing harmful or off-site reaches readers.\n105:62. As an Admin, I want every link and image in `site/` to be a relative path, so that the site works from the GitHub Pages subfolder.\n106:63. As an Admin, I want only the Images of Published Recaps copied into `site/`, so that photos from Drafts never become public.\n107:64. As an Admin, I want `cms deploy` to push `site/` live, so that a Deploy is `cms publish` followed by `cms deploy`.\n111:65. As an Admin, I want `cms backup` to write one dated archive containing the database and all uploaded Images to a folder I choose outside the repository, so that I can keep a private copy on the club's Drive.\n113:67. As a grader, I want the seed script to create one Admin and one Editor (passwords from the environment), a Trip, Recaps in each status, and a Draft and a Published Page, so that I can try every capability on a fresh clone.\n117:**Storage.** SQLite through the standard library, at the existing database path setting. The schema:\n121:- **Recap**: Trip, Owner (an Account), title, Slug (unique per Trip), Body (Markdown), Byline name, Byline class year, status (`draft`, `submitted`, `published`), and created, edited, and Published timestamps.\n122:- **Page**: Owner, title, Slug (unique), Body (Markdown), status (`draft`, `published`), nav position, and created and edited timestamps.\n123:- **Image**: Recap, stored file name, original type, size, alt text.\n124:- **Site state**: a single record holding when `cms publish` last ran, which the \"changes not yet live\" notice uses.\n134:| Draft or Submitted | Published | Admin |\n135:| Published | Draft (Unpublish) | Admin |\nADR-001-local-admin-static-public.md  1.4K\nADR-002-stack.md  1.1K\nADR-003-editors-at-sunday-meetings.md  2.1K\nTraceback (most recent call last):\n  File \"<string>\", line 1, in <module>\nModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'PIL'\n10:    \"python-multipart>=0.0.12\",   # form posts","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"ad88fbe1-97f4-4715-871a-414fcfe51809","timestamp":"2026-10-24T16:43:27.315Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"1:Vocabulary follows `CONTEXT.md`. {"parentUuid":"6ee09e4d-a21c-48b6-bae1-c6cc932d7f35","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"62ba9a60-66fc-40cf-a656-ee766651ee35","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01BdBYgFecr5ugvivtBctAks","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"T05: the Public site for Trips and Recaps.\n\nSeams: `app.publish.render_site(out)` and the `cms publish` command. Content is\nset up through the data modules, then the output folder is read back as a reader\nwould see it.\n\n    index.html                       the home page: Trips with a Published Recap\n    trips/<trip>/index.html          a Trip's Summary, then its Published Recaps\n    trips/<trip>/<recap>/index.html  one Published Recap\n\"\"\"\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import PurePosixPath\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import cli, db, recaps, seed, settings, trips\nfrom app.markdown import render_body\nfrom app.publish import render_site\n\nHOME_PLACEHOLDER = \"https://www.instagram.com/REPLACE-ME/\"\nHOSTILE = (\"Hello **world**.\\n\\n<script>alert(1)</script>\\n\\n\"\n           \"[evil](https://evil.example/x) ![pic](https://evil.example/p.png)\\n\\n\"\n           \"Mail [me](mailto:jane@kenyon.edu) or jane@kenyon.edu\")\n\n\n# ---- helpers --------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef make_trip(slug, start, city=\"Chicago\", summary=\"The overall trip.\"):\n    return trips.create_trip({\n        \"conference\": f\"{city} MUN\", \"city\": city, \"start_date\": start,\n        \"end_date\": start, \"summary\": summary, \"slug\": slug})\n\n\ndef make_recap(trip_id, slug, status=\"published\", body=\"A short anecdote.\",\n               name=\"Jane Doe\", year=2027, published_at=None):\n    \"\"\"A Recap in `status`; (filename, data, content_type)},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef editors_recap(client_as, status=\"draft\"):\n    \"\"\"An Editor's Recap moved to `status`; returns (recap_id,        assert post(editor, f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/submit\").status_code == 303\n    if status == \"published\":\n        assert post(client_as(\"admin\"), f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/publish\"\n if p.is_file()) \\\n        if folder.exists() else []\n\n\ndef upload(c, recap_id, data=PNG, filename=\"holiday.png\",\n           content_type=\"image/png\", alt=ALT, token=True):\n    fields = {\"alt\": alt}\n    if token:\n        fields[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_from(c.get(\"/admin\"))\n    return c.post(f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/images\", data=fields,\n                  files={\"file\": editor client).\"\"\"\n    trip_id = make_trip(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    recap_id = make_recap(editor, trip_id)\n    if status in (\"submitted\", \"published\"):\n         ).status_code == 303\n    return recap_id, editor\n\n\ndef uploaded(client, recap_id, **kwargs):\n    \"\"\"Upload through the route; return the stored file name.\"\"\"\n    before = Images.\n\nSeams: the HTTP app through TestClient, and `app.publish.render_site(out)`.\nRoutes under test:\n\n    POST /admin/recaps/{id}/images                    multipart: file, alt\n    POST /admin/recaps/{id}/images/{image_id}/delete\n    GET  /admin/recaps/{id}/images/{stored file}      the console's own copy\n\nUploads are stored flat in `settings.UPLOADS` (gitignored, outside `site/`).\nAfter an upload the page shows a Markdown snippet `![alt](images/<file>)`.\nA Published Recap's Images are copied next to its page by `render_site`.\n\"\"\"\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_from\nfrom tests.test_t03 import (RECAPS, make_recap, make_trip, post, recap_form,\n                            recap_row, rows, second_editor)\nfrom tests import test_t05\n\nMB = 1024 * 1024\nJPEG = b\"\\xff\\xd8\\xff\\xe0\\x00\\x10JFIF\\x00\" + b\"\\x00\" * 64 + b\"\\xff\\xd9\"\nPNG = b\"\\x89PNG\\r\\n\\x1a\\n\" + b\"\\x00\\x00\\x00\\rIHDR\" + b\"\\x00\" * 64\nWEBP = b\"RIFF\" + (60).to_bytes(4, \"little\") + b\"WEBPVP8 \" + b\"\\x00\" * 52\nGIF = b\"GIF89a\" + b\"\\x00\" * 64\nSAMPLES = {\"jpg\": JPEG, \"png\": PNG, \"webp\": WEBP}\nCONTENT_TYPES = {\"jpg\": \"image/jpeg\", \"png\": \"image/png\", \"webp\": \"image/webp\"}\nSTORED_NAME = re.compile(r\"^[0-9a-f]{16,}\\.(jpg|png|webp)$\")\nSNIPPET = re.compile(r\"!\\[([^\\]]*)\\]\\((images/[^)\\s]+)\\)\")\nALT = \"A crowded committee room\"\n\n\n# ---- helpers --------------------------------------------------------------\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef uploads(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    \"\"\"Each test stores uploads in its own empty folder.\"\"\"\n    folder = tmp_path / \"uploads\"\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"UPLOADS\", folder)\n    return folder\n\n\ndef stored(folder):\n    return sorted(p for p in folder.rglob(\"*\") if p.is_file()) \\\n        if folder.exists() else []\n\n\ndef upload(c, recap_id, data=PNG, filename=\"holiday.png\",\n           content_type=\"image/png\", alt=ALT, token=True):\n    fields = {\"alt\": alt}\n    if token:\n        fields[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_from(c.get(\"/admin\"))\n    return c.post(f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/images\", data=fields,\n                  files={\"file\": (filename, data, content_type)},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef editors_recap(client_as, status=\"draft\"):\n    \"\"\"An Editor's Recap moved to `status`; returns (recap_id, editor client).\"\"\"\n    trip_id = make_trip(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    recap_id = make_recap(editor, trip_id)\n    if status in (\"submitted\", \"published\"):\n        assert post(editor, f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/submit\").status_code == 303\n    if status == \"published\":\n        assert post(client_as(\"admin\"), f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/publish\"\n                    ).status_code == 303\n    return recap_id, editor\n\n\ndef uploaded(client, recap_id, **kwargs):\n    \"\"\"Upload through the route; return the stored file name.\"\"\"\n    before = set(stored(settings.UPLOADS))\n    assert upload(client, recap_id, **kwargs).status_code == 200\n    (new,) = set(stored(settings.UPLOADS)) - before\n    return new.name\n\n\ndef image_rows(recap_id):\n    return rows(\"SELECT * FROM image WHERE recap_id = ?\", recap_id)\n\n\ndef set_body(client, recap_id, body):\n    r = post(client, f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}\", **recap_form(\n        recap_row(recap_id)[\"trip_id\"], body=body,\n        byline_name=\"Contributor Name\", byline_class_year=\"2027\"))\n    assert r.status_code == 303, r.text\n\n\ndef preview_region(html):\n    match = re.search(r'<section id=\"preview\">(.*?)</section>', html, re.S)\n    assert match, \"page has no <section id=\\\"preview\\\">\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef preview(client, recap_id, body):\n    r = post(client, f\"{RECAPS}/{recap_id}/preview\",\n             **recap_form(recap_row(recap_id)[\"trip_id\"], body=body))\n    assert r.status_code == 200\n    return preview_region(r.text)\n\n\n# ---- accepted uploads -----------------------------------------------------\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind\", [\"jpg\", \"png\", \"webp\"])\ndef test_valid_image_is_stored_and_a_markdown_snippet_is_shown(\n        client_as, uploads, kind):\n    recap_id, editor = editors_recap(client_as)\n    r = upload(editor, recap_id, SAMPLES[kind], f\"holiday.{kind}\",\n               CONTENT_TYPES[kind])\n    assert r.status_code == 200\n\n    (path,) = stored(uploads)\n    assert path.read_bytes() == SAMPLES[kind]\n    assert path.suffix == f\".{kind}\"\n    snippet = SNIPPET.search(r.text)\n    assert snippet and snippet.group(1) == ALT\n    assert snippet.group(2) == f\"images/{path.name}\"\n\n    (row,) = image_rows(recap_id)\n    assert row[\"filename\"] == path.name and row[\"alt\"] == ALT\n    assert row[\"content_type\"] == CONTENT_TYPES[kind]\n    assert row[\"size\"] == len(SAMPLES[kind])\n\n\ndef test_the_stored_name_is_generated_never_the_users(client_as, uploads):\n    recap_id, editor = editors_recap(client_as)\n    first = uploaded(editor, recap_id, filename=\"../../etc/holiday photo.png\")\n    second = uploaded(editor, recap_id, filename=\"../../etc/holiday photo.png\")\n    assert STORED_NAME.match(first) and STORED_NAME.match(second)\n    assert first != second\n    assert not [p for p in settings.UPLOADS.parent.rglob(\"*\")\n                if \"holiday\" in p.name]\n\n\ndef test_the_real_type_decides_not_the_extension_or_header(client_as, uploads):\n recap_id)\n    with_image = f\"Look:\\n\\n![{ALT}](images/{name})\"\n    from app import db, recaps\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE recap SET body = ?   recaps.transition(recap_id, \"publish\")\n    return trip_id, recap_id, name\n\n\ndef test_a_published_recaps_image_is_copied_next_to_its_page(\n        client_as, tmp_path):\n    _, _, name = published_recap_with_image(client_as)\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    page = out / \"trips/2026-chicago/food-crawl\"\n    assert (page / \"images\" / name).read_bytes() == PNG\n    html = (page / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert f'<img src=\"images/{name}\" alt=\"{ALT}\">' in html\n\n\ndef test_image_references_in_the_output_are_relative_and_resolve(\n        client_as, tmp_path):\n    published_recap_with_image(client_as)\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    for html_file in out.rglob(\"*.html\"):\n        for src in re.findall(r'src=\"([^\"]*)\"', html_file.read_text()):\n            assert not src.startswith((\"/\", \"http:\", \"https:\", \"//\")), src\n            assert (html_file.parent / src).is_file(), (html_file, src)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"status\", [\"draft\", \"submitted\"])\ndef test_images_of_recaps_that_are_not_published_are_not_copied(\n        client_as, tmp_path, status):\n    _, _, name = published_recap_with_image(client_as, status=status)\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    assert not [p for p in out.rglob(\"*\") if p.name == name]\n    assert not [p for p in out.rglob(\"*\") if p.suffix in (\".png\", \".jpg\", \".webp\")]\n\n\ndef test_only_the_published_recaps_images_are_copied(client_as, tmp_path):\n    trip_id, _, live = published_recap_with_image(client_as)\n    draft = test_t05.make_recap(trip_id, \"draft-one\", status=\"draft\")\n    hidden = uploaded(client_as(\"admin\"), draft)\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    names = {p.name for p in out.rglob(\"*\") if p.is_file()}\n    assert live in names and hidden not in names\n\n\ndef test_an_unpublished_recaps_image_leaves_the_output(client_as, tmp_path):\n    _, recap_id, name = published_recap_with_image(client_as)\n    from app import recaps\n    recaps.transition(recap_id, \"unpublish\")\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    assert not [p for p in out.rglob(\"*\") if p.name == name]\n\n\ndef test_a_published_page_never_shows_an_external_or_foreign_image(\n        client_as, tmp_path):\n    trip_id = test_t05.make_trip(\"2026-chicago\", \"2026-03-01\")\n    test_t05.make_recap(trip_id, \"hostile\", body=test_t05.HOSTILE)\n    other = test_t05.make_recap(trip_id, \"other\", status=\"draft\")\n    foreign = uploaded(client_as(\"admin\"), other)\n    from app import db\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE recap SET body = ? WHERE slug = 'hostile'\",\n                     (f\"![x](images/{foreign}) ![y](https://evil.example/p.png)\",))\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    html = (out / \"trips/2026-chicago/hostile/index.html\").read_text()\n    assert \"<img\" not in html and \"evil.example\" not in html\n    assert not [p for p in out.rglob(\"*\") if p.name == foreign]\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ace385b7-d12d-4970-86f9-c28b45de5a06","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"12a2e82c-7c9c-494d-87fb-28f352e825f6","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

extension, content_type = kind\n\n    filename = f\"{secrets.token_hex(16)}.{extension}\"\n    settings.UPLOADS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    path = settings.UPLOADS / filename\n    path.write_bytes(data)\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            cur = conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO image (recap_id, filename, content_type, size, alt) \"\n editor_id,\n                 \"content_type\": content_type, \"size\": len(data), \"alt\": alt})\n            if cur.rowcount == 0:\n                path.unlink()\n                return None\n            return conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM image WHERE id = ?\",\n                                (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    except BaseException:\n        path.unlink(missing_ok=True)\n I'll start by fixing the delete route issue.\n\n","signature":""},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01S1FXzvjvdBQ8px5RuwgW3K","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd /Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms && python3 - <<'EOF'\np=\"app/images.py\"; s=open(p).read()\ns+='''\n\ndef get_image(image_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM image WHERE id = ?\",\n                            (image_id,)).fetchone()\n\n\ndef remove_files(filenames: list[str]) -> None:\n    for filename in filenames:\n        (settings.UPLOADS / filename).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n\n\ndef delete_image(image_id: int, recap_id: int,\n                 editor_id: int | None = None) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Delete one Image of a Recap, row and file. False, deleting nothing, if\n    `editor_id` no longer owns a Draft Recap `recap_id`.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(\n            f\"SELECT filename FROM image WHERE id = :image_id \"\n            f\"AND recap_id = :recap_id AND {_RECAP_OPEN}\",\n            {\"image_id\": image_id, \"recap_id\": recap_id,\n             \"editor_id\": editor_id}).fetchone()\n        if row is None:\n            return False\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM image WHERE id = ?\", (image_id,))\n    remove_files([row[\"filename\"]])\n    return True\n'''\nopen(p,\"w\").write(s)\np=\"app/routes/recaps.py\"; s=open(p).read()\ns=s.replace('''@router.post(\"/{recap_id}/delete\")''','''@router.post(\"/{recap_id}/images/{image_id}/delete\")\ndef delete_image(recap_id: int, image_id: int,\n                 account: Account = Depends(require(\"console.view\"))):\n    _allowed_recap(recap_id, account, \"recaps.edit\")\n    image = images.get_image(image_id)\n    if image is None or image[\"recap_id\"] != recap_id:\n        raise HTTPException(404, \"No such Image\")\n    if not images.delete_image(image_id, recap_id, _editor_id(account)):\n        raise HTTPException(409, LOCKED_ERROR)\n    return RedirectResponse(f\"/admin/recaps/{recap_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{recap_id}/delete\")''',1)\nopen(p,\"w\").write(s)\nEOF\nuv run pytest tests/test_t06.py -q -k \"delete and not recap_removes and not admin_deleting and not refused_recap\" 2>&1 | tail -3","description":"Implement image delete route and run delete tests"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

{"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"12a2e82c-7c9c-494d-87fb-28f352e825f6","hash":"c3044d77df933fa51cc9dbbb90ae930e2ad0c53c817b622c7face45a196095ee","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_01Qk92QE2tbMjU8Af8y58o45","content":"Launching skill: code-review"},{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/andrewv/.claude/skills/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nAnything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: Review the uncommitted T06 changes (git diff HEAD plus new files app/images.py and tests/test_t06.py) against ticket #7 and the spec. {"parentUuid":"04373783-bb1e-4cd4-9a34-966d7a541322","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"f97bd58e-0b2c-498a-905e-e033b1f93910","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/andrewv/.claude/skills/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nAnything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: Review the uncommitted T06 changes (git diff HEAD plus new files app/images.py and tests/test_t06.py) against ticket #7 and the spec. Focus: upload validation bypasses (magic bytes, polyglots, SVG/HTML disguised, spoofed Content-Type/extension, size limit enforced while streaming, zero-byte), path traversal/filename injection, alt text escaping in snippet/Preview/published HTML, CSRF on upload/delete, access control, cleanup of files and rows, render_site (only Published images, no external URLs, relative paths at each depth). Report findings only; change no files, post no comment."}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"5fe650fb-1b02-4b72-99b8-e4769c83e996","timestamp":"2026-10-24T16:54:02.807Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_01Qk92QE2tbMjU8Af8y58o45","session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"12a2e82c-7c9c-494d-87fb-28f352e825f6","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}
